messages.raw: §aYou use your mana to pull a book out. Most of it is unreadable but you do notice a 2 and a 22...
messages.text: You use your mana to pull a book out. Most of it is unreadable but you do notice a 2 and a 22...
messages.gloss: 页面明确呈现的游戏聊天；2 与 22 是固定解谜线索，不是属性、数量进度或采样玩家值。
messages.zh: 你用法力抽出一本书。大部分内容都辨认不清，但你注意到了一个 2 和一个 22……
